propositions: Recalled plan-review findings are re-emitted on every subsequent review with empty evidence lists, blocking convergence in the revise-review loop because pass1.run_pass1 injects prior concerns with hardcoded `evidence: []` and `impact: ""`
Prior concerns carry no persisted grounding evidence to Pass-2 verification, so the verifier rubber-stamps bare assertions instead of re-testing original quotes against the current plan text
The recall eligibility filter selects findings on priority and decision alone without consulting material_fingerprint, causing re-emission even when plan edits resolve the finding
A recalled finding is re-decided as block and re-persisted without the _recall marker, making it indistinguishable from fresh findings and re-qualifying for recall indefinitely

The fix restores evidence and impact from prior findings into injected candidates, suppresses recall for evidence-less priors, and gates recall on material_fingerprint matching between prior and current sidecars
